name: Glia (astrocyte, oligodendrocyte, microglia)
failures: Reactive gliosis forming the scar that blocks CNS repair, demyelination, chronic neuroinflammation.

see.note: PET ligands report microglial activation coarsely; astrocyte state is inaccessible.

model.note: Reactive gliosis is protective and obstructive at once. No agreed healthy target.

reach.note: Same barrier problem as neurons, with less cell-type specificity.

edit.note: Remyelination remains unachieved in humans despite decades of trials.

anchors: Zebrafish Müller glia regenerate retina; human glia do not
